newsitem.title: POLAND: Swarzedz surges on October net profit.
newsitem.headline: Swarzedz surges on October net profit.

text.p: Polish furniture maker Swarzedz SA surged the daily maximum 10 percent to 7.7 zlotys in light trade after making a net profit in October after a hitherto dismal 1996, analysts said.
The firm earned 200,000 zlotys in October after losing 34 million zlotys over the first three quarters this year.
"The rise shows an investor or investors think the firm will be able to turn around its situation," one trader said.
Swarzedz's supervisory board last month approved an outline restructuring plan for 1997-99 to be presented to the firm's creditors. -- Warsaw Newsroom +48 22 653 9700
